name: Watlaharnrai Half Marathon (5th ed.)
short_description: The Watlaharnrai Half Marathon is a 21.1km race held at Wat La Harn Rai in Ban Khai, Rayong, Thailand on September 6, 2026.
ai_summary: The Watlaharnrai Half Marathon is a 21.1km road race set to take place on September 6, 2026, at Wat La Harn Rai in Ban Khai, Rayong, Thailand. This will be the event's 5th edition. Registration details have not yet been announced, so prospective participants will need to check back for further updates before signing up.

research_highlights: The 21km half marathon route is described as mostly flat with long undulating hills, based on the official 2025 (4th edition) course description.
Half marathon start time is 05:00 with cut-offs at 07:30 (first) and 09:30 (second)/finish, per the 2025 edition details.
For the 2026 (5th) edition, organizers state the half marathon course (21.4km) has been newly measured and certified by World Athletics/AIMS, starting at 05:00.
The event is a charity run organized with Wat Laharnrai temple to raise funds for constructing a Buddha statue (Phra Buddha Suwannaphanwichit) and commemorate revered monk Luang Pu Tim Isariko.
Distances offered include Half Marathon (21km/21.4km), Mini Marathon (10-11km), and Fun Run (4-5km), with race shirts, finisher shirts, medals, and chip timing included.
research_watchouts: No first-hand participant race reports, reviews, or community discussion of course conditions, heat, or crowd support were found in available search results — most available material is organizer/registration listings rather than runner feedback.
Race details (distance, fees, cut-off times) have varied slightly between editions, so participants should verify the current year's official page rather than relying on prior editions' figures.
